evidence: A worktree creation helper used local path=...; zsh treats path as special PATH mirror and subsequent git calls failed with 'command not found: git'. Renaming the variable to wt_root fixed it.
items.summary: zsh local variable named path can shadow PATH during worktree creation

evidence: 2026-06-08: just dev continues after acquisition-api/cadence-engine failures; tcp to 139.59.135.253:5432 timed out; docker-compose database path maps 5434, currently occupied by another container, so compose-up was not run without operator approval.
items.summary: timwe-subscription just dev database-backed services block before binding when configured Postgres is unreachable

evidence: GET http://localhost:8084/v1/admin/tenants/workspaces returned 404 because port 8084 was bound by services/notification; scripts/just/timwe.sh used next_port and could move notification from 8082 to the acquisition-api port.
items.summary: timwe just start-binary silently shifted fixed service ports
